title: Sourcebot v6
summary: Ask Sourcebot and MCP are now free for teams of up to five users.
body_markdown:
Sourcebot v6 makes previously paid features (including Ask Sourcebot and MCP) free for teams of up to five users.


We're also close sourcing Sourcebot, read[our blog](https://www.sourcebot.dev/blog/sourcebot-is-now-closed-source) to learn more about this change.


## New pricing


We want individual developers and small teams to be able to use all of the core functionality of Sourcebot for free, which is why we're introducing the following new pricing plans:


Plan Pricing Users What's included


**Basic** Free Up to 5 Code search, code navigation, Ask Sourcebot, SSO, REST API, and MCP.


**Pro** $20 USD/user/month, billed annually; $25 USD/user/month, billed monthly Unlimited Everything in Basic, plus permission syncing, organization management, and analytics.


[Compare the plans](https://www.sourcebot.dev/pricing) for the full breakdown. Existing subscriptions will keep their current terms through the end of the current subscription term.
